title: Zapier integration never refreshes the OAuth token because the API returns 403 or 400 on expiry
symptoms: Zaps fail with the API's token expired message until the user reconnects
autoRefresh is on but refreshAccessToken never runs
Only APIs that answer 401 refresh correctly
cause: With autoRefresh, platform core throws RefreshAuthError only for a 401 response. Any other status for an expired token is treated as an ordinary error.
fix: Detect the API's expiry response in afterResponse and throw z.errors.RefreshAuthError yourself.
affected: zapier-platform-core with OAuth2 autoRefresh or session auth, as of 2026-10
